releaseNotes.zh: 新增热补丁提示，可查看预计大小、下载进度和速度。邮箱账号可直接接收个人 AI 点数，已有邀请码保留共享余额。开启同步后，离线改动会在联网返回 App 时补传。Android 请覆盖安装以保留本机数据。
releaseNotes.en: See when an update is available, its estimated download size, progress and speed. Verified email accounts can receive personal AI credits. Existing invitations keep their shared balances. With sync enabled, offline edits upload when you return to the app online. Install over your existing Android app to keep local data.
